A Complete Guide to ICF Certification with Coach Masters Academy

Over the years, people worldwide have started realizing the transformative power of coaching. As a result, not only are more individuals seeking coaching to achieve a goal in their lives, but many are also looking to build their careers in the profession. Many aspirants are willing to learn coaching, specifically the certification process offered by the International Coaching Federation (ICF).

However, with overwhelming information available online, it is easy to be misguided. So if you are a coach aspirant, seeking the most accurate and relevant information, it’s important to understand the role of the International Coaching Federation (ICF). The ICF is the leading governing body for coaches and coaching training providers and sets industry standards for certification.

The ICF offers three coaching credentials: Associate Certified Coach (ACC), Professional Certified Coach (PCC), and Master Certified Coach (MCC). While it is important to note that the ICF doesn’t offer training programs directly, it certifies programs that meet their rigorous criteria. This is where Coach Masters Academy comes in.

Coach Masters Academy provides ICF-accredited coaching training programs that prepare you to meet the requirements for the coaching credentials. Whether you are just starting your coaching career or want to advance to the next level, CMA’s coaching programs ensure you receive the highest-quality education needed to earn an ICF credential.

Why CMA’s ICF-accredited Coaching Courses

What sets Coach Masters Academy (CMA) apart is our ICF-accredited training that integrates a proprietary coaching approach designed for transformative change. It includes a unique Awareness-Clarity-Choice Conversation framework, which goes beyond traditional coaching methods, enabling coaches to facilitate deep, meaningful transformation in their clients.

By combining this powerful framework with ICF-approved standards, CMA ensures that the training meets the rigorous certification requirements while equipping you with the necessary skills to create a sustainable impact in your coaching practice. This blend of high-quality education and transformative methodology makes CMA the ideal choice for anyone seeking to master their coaching career.

Now, let’s dive deeper to understand each ICF coaching certificate and ways to achieve it.

1.   Associate Coaching Certification Program (ACC)

The Associate Coaching Certification (ACC) Program is similar to earning an associate degree—offering a solid base in coaching. Having this certification, you obtain essential coaching tools that can open doors in both your personal and professional life.

Coach Masters Academy (CMA) offers a flexible, ICF-accredited coaching training program to help you achieve this. The core training spans 70 hours and is available in both online and blended formats. CMA’s structured 12-week online program offers flexibility and allows you to complete your training at your own pace. Once you finish the training, you can submit a recorded coaching session and pass an online test to finalize your ACC certification, setting the stage for your coaching career.

2.    Professional Coaching Certification Program (PCC)

If you want to take your coaching skills to the next level, earn a Professional Coaching Certification (PCC), which will solidify your status as a true professional. By earning a PCC credential, you not only demonstrate your commitment but also the expertise that you gained through comprehensive education and practice.

At CMA, the second-level advanced training for mastery coaching provides 80 hours of in-depth coach training, delivered entirely online for seven months. This program focuses on improving your coaching skills, enabling you to effectively guide your clients through meaningful transformations and deliver lasting change.

3.   Master Coaching Certification Program (MCC)

In the coaching industry, the Master Coaching Certification (MCC) is considered the gold standard and is for coaches seeking to master their skills and be recognized as experts.

CMA offers a third-level mastery training program, focusing on artful coaching. This program, which spans seven months with 80 hours of advanced training delivered 100% online, prepares you to become a true master in your field. Upon completion of this ICF coaching course, you become eligible to apply for the MCC credential through the ICF.

ICF Coaching Certification Training with Coach Masters Academy

At Coach Masters Academy (CMA), every step of your coaching education is designed to guide you toward achieving your certification goals while equipping you with the skills required for long-term success in the coaching industry. From the foundational ACC program to the advanced PCC and mastery-level MCC certifications, with CMA’s ICF-accredited coaching courses, you can get transformative and sustainable results at each stage of your journey.

Moreover, with a blend of innovative learning formats, practical experience, and CMA’s proprietary conversation framework, you can gain the tools to meet certification requirements and create lasting, transformative change in the lives of your clients. Whether you are just starting or want to advance to coaching mastery, CMA can support you at every step, preparing you for a rewarding and impactful coaching career.
